compile_pilot.training_success_rule: First three non-interrupted agent traces, including unsuccessful outcomes. Provider-interrupted episodes remain evaluation failures but cannot supply complete traces.
compile_pilot.trigger: Prescheduled guard validation, not the PACE projected compilation trigger.

scope.failure_rule: No retries. Unknown provider billing aborts the affected task, retaining its worst-case reservation. Independent predeclared tasks continue only within remaining bounds. Three consecutive unsettled/provider errors stop the batch. Invalid pricing/identity/reservation evidence stops immediately. GUI action errors are observed until the fixed total 20-call service cap.
scope.reference: Supplied per-arrival billing allowance, not measured agent-only bill or estimated true upper bound.
scope.role: Deployment components plus a single cold-build pilot after three live agent traces. Fixed existing deployment program; no full online selection claim.
scope.routing: One supplied family. No router model call, tau0=m=0.
